# Rust execution-slice projection

Rust touchpoints include CLI operations, APIs, protocol traces, downstream consumer fixtures, component/integration tests, packaged artifacts, migration rehearsals, and measured benchmarks.

A slice closes enough domain, application, adapter, and evidence work to make one observation real. It may span several work units and crates. It must identify candidate and validation boundaries, assertion evidence, an integration owner, containment/rollback behavior, and temporary scaffolding disposition.

Do not sequence indefinitely as types, storage, services, adapters, and UI layers with no integrated observation. A bounded foundation exception must retire a named risk and enable a named next slice.
